title: The Telecommunications Handbook: Engineering Guidelines for Fixed, Mobile and Satellite Systems
description:
This practical handbook and reference provides a complete understanding of the telecommunications field supported by descriptions and case examples throughout

Taking a practical approach, The Telecommunications Handbook examines the principles and details of all of the major and modern telecommunications systems currently available to industry and to end-users. It gives essential information about usage, architectures, functioning, planning, construction, measurements and optimisation. The structure of the book is modular, giving both overall descriptions of the architectures and functionality of typical use cases, as well as deeper and practical guidelines for telecom professionals.

The focus of the book is on current and future networks, and the most up-to-date functionalities of each network are described in sufficient detail for deployment purposes. The contents include an introduction to each technology, its evolution path, feasibility and utilization, solution and network architecture, and technical functioning of the systems (signalling, coding, different modes for channel delivery and security of core and radio system). The planning of the core and radio networks (system-specific field test measurement guidelines, hands-on network planning advices and suggestions for the parameter adjustments) and future systems are also described.

Each chapter covers aspects individually for easy reference, including approaches such as: functional blocks, protocol layers, hardware and software, planning, optimization, use cases, challenges, solutions to potential problems

Provides very practical detail on the planning and operation of networks to enable readers to apply the content in real-world deployments

Bridges the gap between the communications in the academic context and the practical knowledge and skills needed to work in the telecommunications industry

Section divisions include: General theory; Fixed telecommunications; Mobile communications; Space communications; Other and special communications; and Planning and management of telecommunication networks

Covers new commercial and enhanced systems deployed, such as IPv6 based networks, LTE-Advanced and GALILEO

An essential reference for Technical personnel at telecom operators; equipment and terminal manufacturers; Engineers working for network operators.

Proporciona información esencial sobre el uso, arquitecturas, funcionamiento, planificación, construcción, mediciones y optimización. title: AI-First Healthcare
description:
AI is poised to transform every aspect of healthcare, including the way we manage personal health, from customer experience and clinical care to healthcare cost reductions. This practical book is one of the first to describe present and future use cases where AI can help solve pernicious healthcare problems.

Kerrie Holley and Siupo Becker provide guidance to help informatics and healthcare leadership create AI strategy and implementation plans for healthcare. With this book, business stakeholders and practitioners will be able to build knowledge, a roadmap, and the confidence to support AIin their organizations—without getting into the weeds of algorithms or open source frameworks.

Cowritten by an AI technologist and a medical doctor who leverages AI to solve healthcare’s most difficult challenges, this book covers:

The myths and realities of AI, now and in the future
Human-centered AI: what it is and how to make it possible
Using various AI technologies to go beyond precision medicine
How to deliver patient care using the IoT and ambient computing with AI
How AI can help reduce waste in healthcare
AI strategy and how to identify high-priority AI application

Este libro práctico es uno de los primeros en describir casos de uso presente y futuro donde AI puede ayudar a resolver problemas de salud perniciosos.

Kerrie Holley y Siupo Becker proporcionan orientación para ayudar a la informática y el liderazgo sanitario a crear estrategias de IA y planes de implementación para la salud. Con este libro, los actores empresariales y los practicantes podrán construir conocimientos, una hoja de ruta y la confianza para apoyar a AIin sus organizaciones, sin entrar en las malas hierbas de algoritmos o marcos de código abierto.

Coescrito por un tecnólogo de AI y un médico que aprovecha la IA para resolver los retos más difíciles de la salud, este libro cubre:

Los mitos y realidades de AI, ahora y en el futuro
IA centrada en el ser humano: lo que es y cómo hacerlo posible
Utilizando diversas tecnologías de IA para ir más allá de la medicina de precisión
Cómo ofrecer atención al paciente utilizando el IoT y computación ambiental con AI
Cómo AI puede ayudar a reducir los residuos en la salud
Estrategia de IA y cómo identificar aplicaciones de IA de alta prioridad

title: Haskell in Depth
description:
Turn the corner from “Haskell student” to “Haskell developer.” Haskell in Depth explores the important language features and programming skills you’ll need to build production-quality software using Haskell. And along the way, you’ll pick up some interesting insights into why Haskell looks and works the way it does. Get ready to go deep!About the TechnologySoftware for high-precision tasks like financial transactions, defense systems, and scientific research must be absolutely, provably correct. As a purely functional programming language, Haskell enforces a mathematically rigorous approach that can lead to concise, efficient, and bug-free code. To write such code you’ll need deep understanding. You can get it from this book!About the BookHaskell in Depth unlocks a new level of skill with this challenging language. Going beyond the basics of syntax and structure, this book opens up critical topics like advanced types, concurrency, and data processing. You’ll discover key parts of the Haskell ecosystem and master core design patterns that will transform how you write software.What's Inside
Building applications, web services, and networking apps
Using sophisticated libraries like lens, singletons, and servant
Organizing projects with Cabal and Stack
Error-handling and testing
Pure parallelism for multicore processors
About the ReaderFor developers familiar with Haskell basics.About the AuthorVitaly Bragilevsky has been teaching Haskell and functional programming since 2008. He is a member of the GHC Steering Committee.QuotesA clearly written guide. It’ll take your Haskell skills beyond the ‘getting started’ level.- Phillip Sorensen, Cornell UniversityPacked full of practical knowledge to level up your design skills.- Jose Luis Garcia, NielsenA practical book for real-world Haskell programs. It expands your Haskell knowledge to new frontiers.- David Paccoud, BioclinicaOne of the most richly-detailed books on programming that I’ve encountered. Rewarding on many levels.- Charles Earl, Automattic

Creación de aplicaciones, servicios web y aplicaciones de redes
Usando bibliotecas sofisticadas como lente, singletons y sirviente
Organizar proyectos con Cabal y Stack
Manejo de errores y pruebas
Paralelismo puro para procesadores multicore
Sobre el lectorPara desarrolladores que conocen los conceptos básicos de Haskell. Sobre el AutorVitaly Bragilevsky ha estado enseñando Haskell y programación funcional desde 2008. title: Fitness for Geeks
description: If you’re interested in how things work, this guide will help you experiment with one crucial system you usually ignore—your body and its health. Long hours focusing on code or circuits tends to stifle notions of nutrition, but with this educational and highly useful book you can approach fitness through science, whether it’s investigating your ancestral health or using the latest self-tracking apps and gear.
translatedDescription: Si te interesa cómo funcionan las cosas, esta guía te ayudará a experimentar con un sistema crucial que normalmente ignoras: tu cuerpo y su salud. Las largas horas centrándose en el código o los circuitos tienden a sofocar las nociones de nutrición, pero con este libro educativo y muy útil se puede acercar a la aptitud a través de la ciencia, ya sea investigando su salud ancestral o utilizando las últimas aplicaciones y equipos de auto rastreo.

title: IoT Projects with NVIDIA Jetson Nano: AI-Enabled Internet of Things Projects for Beginners
description:
Explore the capabilities of the NVIDIA Jetson Nano, an IoT device designed to perform computations like a computer desktop. This book will show you how to build your first project and optimize your devices, programs, and daily activities with the AI computation abilities of the Jetson Nano. 
This board consists of CPU Quad-core ARM A57 @ 1.43 GHz and GPU 128-core Maxwell. With this hardware specification, the board can run multiple neural networks in parallel for complex AI applications. With the integrated sensor and actuators, this board enables stronger IoT solutions and provides more advanced capabilities.
Discover how develop complex IoT projects with the Jetson Nano today.
What You’ll Learn
Set up NVIDIA Jetson Nano device
Build applications like image classification, object detection, segmentation, and speech processing
Use the Jetson Nano to process daily computer activities such as browsing the internet, checking emails, or playing music and videos
Implement machine learning computations into your projects
Who This Book Is For
Makers, developers, students, and professional of all levels who are new to the NVIDIA Jetson Nano technology.
translatedDescription:
Explore las capacidades de la NVIDIA Jetson Nano, un dispositivo IoT diseñado para realizar computaciones como un escritorio de computadora. Este libro le mostrará cómo construir su primer proyecto y optimizar sus dispositivos, programas y actividades diarias con las habilidades de computación AI del Jetson Nano.
Esta tabla consta de CPU Quad-core ARM A57 @ 1.43 GHz y GPU 128-core Maxwell. Con esta especificación de hardware, la junta puede ejecutar múltiples redes neuronales en paralelo para aplicaciones complejas de IA. Con el sensor integrado y los actuadores, esta junta permite soluciones de IoT más fuertes y ofrece capacidades más avanzadas.
Descubra cómo desarrollar proyectos complejos de IoT con el Jetson Nano hoy.
Lo que aprenderás
Configurar dispositivo NVIDIA Jetson Nano
Construir aplicaciones como clasificación de imágenes, detección de objetos, segmentación y procesamiento del habla
Utilice el Jetson Nano para procesar actividades informáticas diarias como navegar por Internet, revisar correos electrónicos o reproducir música y vídeos
Implementar computaciones de aprendizaje automático en sus proyectos
Quién es este libro
Fabricantes, desarrolladores, estudiantes y profesionales de todos los niveles que son nuevos en la tecnología NVIDIA Jetson Nano.

title: Building a Virtual Assistant for Raspberry Pi: The Practical Guide for Constructing a Voice-Controlled Virtual Assistant
description:
This new edition of Building a Virtual Assistant for Raspberry Pi will provide new features to your virtual assistant, Melissa, adding advanced capabilities to her. Updated to the latest Python release (Python 3), the book will follow the same structure as its previous edition with new features discussed as you move forward.

After walking you through the various STTs, TTSs, and implementation of these components with the Python 3, you will learn about Large Language Models (LLMs) and how to run them on Raspberry Pi. You will build applications/modules for Melissa that will be used by the LLM. The book will feature Plugin Architecture Implementation for Melissa, allowing users to script their own interactions with Melissa. You will also enable Melissa to interact with resources on the internet. In addition to Melissa's voice controlled interface for notes management, this edition will also enable Melissa to be intelligent to assist you with your tasks.

Adding to Melissa’s voice interface from the first edition, you will use an LLM to make Melissa intelligent. You will learn about function calling, providing Melissa access to tools. In conclusion, you will make a smart virtual assistant that runs on Raspberry Pi. 

What You'll Learn

Implement plugin architecture to enable quicker scripting
Develop modules for conversational interaction with the assistant
Run the local LLM instance to empower Melissa with intelligence
Interact with both public and restricted APIs (Application Programming Interfaces)

Who This Book Is For

Anyone who has built a home automation project with Raspberry Pi and now want to enhance it by making it voice-controlled. The book would also interest students from computer science or related disciplines.
translatedDescription:
Esta nueva edición de Building a Virtual Assistant for Raspberry Pi proporcionará nuevas características a su asistente virtual, Melissa, añadiendo capacidades avanzadas a ella. Actualizado a la última versión de Python (Python 3), el libro seguirá la misma estructura que su edición anterior con nuevas características discutidas mientras avanza.

Después de caminar a través de los diversos STTs, TTSs y la implementación de estos componentes con el Python 3, usted aprenderá acerca de los modelos de lenguaje grande (LLMs) y cómo ejecutarlos en Raspberry Pi. Usted construirá aplicaciones/módulos para Melissa que será utilizado por el LLM. El libro contará con Implementación de Arquitectura de Plugin para Melissa, permitiendo a los usuarios script sus propias interacciones con Melissa. También permitirá que Melissa interactúe con recursos en Internet. Además de la interfaz controlada por voz de Melissa para la gestión de notas, esta edición también permitirá que Melissa sea inteligente para ayudarle con sus tareas.

Añadiendo a la interfaz de voz de Melissa desde la primera edición, usarás un LLM para que Melissa sea inteligente. Aprenderás acerca de la función llamando, proporcionando a Melissa acceso a herramientas. En conclusión, usted hará un asistente virtual inteligente que funciona en Raspberry Pi.

Lo que aprenderás

Implementar la arquitectura plugin para habilitar scripting más rápido
Desarrollar módulos para la interacción con el asistente
Ejecute la instancia local de LLM para empoderar a Melissa con inteligencia
Interactúa con API públicas y restringidas (Interfaces de programación de aplicaciones)

Quién es este libro

Cualquier persona que haya construido un proyecto de automatización de casa con Raspberry Pi y ahora quiere mejorarlo mediante el control de voz. El libro también interesaría a estudiantes de informática o disciplinas relacionadas.

title: Building IoT Systems: Design Scalable IoT Systems from Edge to Cloud
description:
Explore the world of IoT and discover how various methodologies are used to manage edge devices and data flow through different layers. This concise guide takes a practical approach to designing scalable IoT systems and how cloud computing helps to maintain them.

 With a keen eye on data flow, you’ll examine how to work with different components and how to process and store data. You’ll work with different protocols like MQTT and see how they can be used in combination with standard web protocols for managing IoT systems. Finally, you’ll look at key topics such as device management, event handling, OTA, device security, device-to-cloud communication, cloud-to-device communication, and more. 

This guide is your fast track to building IoT systems and gaining an in-depth understanding of the core components of edge and cloud computing.

What You Will Learn

Build scalable IoT systems
Find out how IoT components communicate
Understand data pipelines in IoT

Who This Book Is For

Beginning to intermediate level readers who want to understand the process through which the data flows from an edge device to the cloud, to manage IoT systems.
translatedDescription:
Explore el mundo de IoT y descubra cómo se utilizan diversas metodologías para gestionar dispositivos de borde y flujo de datos a través de diferentes capas. Esta guía concisa toma un enfoque práctico para diseñar sistemas IoT escalables y cómo la computación de nubes ayuda a mantenerlos.

Con un buen ojo en el flujo de datos, examinará cómo trabajar con diferentes componentes y cómo procesar y almacenar datos. Trabajarás con diferentes protocolos como MQTT y verás cómo se pueden utilizar en combinación con protocolos web estándar para gestionar sistemas IoT. Por último, verás temas clave como la gestión de dispositivos, el manejo de eventos, OTA, seguridad de dispositivos, comunicación de dispositivo a tapa, comunicación de nube a dispositivo y más.

Esta guía es su vía rápida para construir sistemas IoT y obtener una comprensión profunda de los componentes básicos de la computación de bordes y nubes.

Qué aprenderás

Sistemas IoT escalables
Descubra cómo se comunican los componentes de IoT
Comprender los oleoductos de datos en IoT

Quién es este libro

Empezando a lectores de nivel intermedio que quieren comprender el proceso a través del cual los datos fluyen de un dispositivo de borde a la nube, para gestionar los sistemas de IoT.

title: The Robotic Process Automation Handbook: A Guide to Implementing RPA Systems
description:
While Robotic Process Automation (RPA) has been around for about 20 years, it has hit an inflection point because of the convergence of cloud computing, big data and AI. This book shows you how to leverage RPA effectively in your company to  automate repetitive and rules-based processes, such as scheduling, inputting/transferring data, cut and paste, filling out forms, and search. 

Using practical aspects of implementing the technology (based on case studies and industry best practices), you’ll see how companies have been able to realize substantial ROI (Return On Investment) with their implementations, such as by lessening the need for hiring or outsourcing. By understanding the core concepts of RPA, you’ll also see that the technology significantly increases compliance – leading to fewer issues with regulations – and minimizes costly errors. 

RPA software revenues have recently soared by over 60 percent, which is the fastest ramp in the tech industry, and they are expected to exceed $1 billion by the end of 2019. It is generally seamless with legacy IT environments, making it easier for companies to pursue a strategy of digital transformation and can even be a gateway to AI. The Robotic Process Automation Handbook puts everything you need to know into one place to be a part of this wave.

 What You'll Learn

Develop the right strategy and plan
Deal with resistance and fears from employees
Take an in-depth look at the leading RPA systems, including where they are most effective, the risks and the costs
Evaluate an RPA system

Who This Book Is For 

IT specialists and managers at mid-to-large companies
translatedDescription:
Mientras que la automatización del proceso robótico (RPA) ha estado alrededor de 20 años, ha alcanzado un punto de inflexión debido a la convergencia de la computación de la nube, los grandes datos y la IA. Este libro le muestra cómo aprovechar RPA de manera efectiva en su empresa para automatizar procesos repetitivos y basados en reglas, tales como programación, entrada/transferir datos, corte y pasta, rellenar formularios y búsqueda.

Utilizando aspectos prácticos de la implementación de la tecnología (basado en estudios de casos y mejores prácticas de la industria), verás cómo las empresas han podido realizar un ROI sustancial (Return On Investment) con sus implementaciones, como por ejemplo reduciendo la necesidad de contratación o externalización. Al entender los conceptos básicos de RPA, también verás que la tecnología aumenta significativamente el cumplimiento – lo que lleva a menos problemas con las regulaciones – y minimiza errores costosos.

Los ingresos del software RPA han aumentado recientemente en más del 60%, que es la rampa más rápida de la industria tecnológica, y se espera que superen los 1.000 millones de dólares para finales de 2019. Por lo general, es impecable con entornos de TI heredados, lo que facilita a las empresas perseguir una estrategia de transformación digital e incluso puede ser una puerta de entrada a AI. El manual de automatización del proceso robótico pone todo lo que necesitas saber en un lugar para formar parte de esta ola.

Lo que aprenderás

Elaborar la estrategia y el plan adecuados
Tratar con resistencia y miedos de los empleados
Evaluar en profundidad los principales sistemas de RPA, incluso donde son más eficaces, los riesgos y los costos
Evaluar un sistema RPA

Quién es este libro

Especialistas y gerentes de TI en empresas medianas a grandes

title: Programming the Internet of Things
description:
Learn how to program the Internet of Things with this hands-on guide. By breaking down IoT programming complexities in step-by-step, building-block fashion, author and educator Andy King shows you how to design and build your own full-stack, end-to-end IoT solution--from device to cloud. This practical book walks you through tooling, development environment setup, solution design, and implementation.

You'll learn how a typical IoT ecosystem works, as well as how to tackle integration challenges that crop up when implementing your own IoT solution. Whether you're an engineering student learning the basics of the IoT, a tech-savvy executive looking to better understand the nuances of IoT technology stacks, or a programmer building your own smart house solution, this practical book will help you get started.

Design an end-to-end solution that implements an IoT use case
Set up an IoT-centric development and testing environment
Organize your software design by creating abstractions in Python and Java
Use MQTT, CoAP, and other protocols to connect IoT devices and services
Create a custom JSON-based data format that's consumable across a range of platforms and services
Use cloud services to support your IoT ecosystem and provide business value for stakeholders
translatedDescription:
Aprende a programar el Internet de las cosas con esta guía práctica. Al descomponer las complejidades de programación de IoT en forma paso a paso, edificio-block, autor y educador Andy King le muestra cómo diseñar y construir su propia solución IoT de punta a punta, de dispositivo a nube. Este libro práctico te lleva a través de herramientas, configuración del entorno de desarrollo, diseño de soluciones y implementación.

Aprenderás cómo funciona un ecosistema típico de IoT, así como cómo abordar retos de integración que surgen al implementar tu propia solución de IoT. Ya sea que sea un estudiante de ingeniería aprendiendo los fundamentos del IoT, un ejecutivo con tecnología que busca comprender mejor los matices de las pilas de tecnología IoT, o un programador que construye su propia solución de casa inteligente, este libro práctico le ayudará a empezar.

Diseñar una solución de extremo a extremo que implemente un caso de uso IoT
Establecer un entorno de desarrollo y pruebas centrado en IoT
Organiza tu diseño de software creando abstracciones en Python y Java
Utilice MQTT, CoAP y otros protocolos para conectar dispositivos y servicios IoT
Cree un formato de datos personalizado basado en JSON que sea consumible en una gama de plataformas y servicios
Utilice servicios en la nube para apoyar su ecosistema de IoT y proporcionar valor comercial para los interesados

title: Learn Robotics Programming - Second Edition
description:
Learn Robotics Programming is your gateway to the world of robotics, offering step-by-step guidance on constructing and programming an AI-enabled robot. Using the Raspberry Pi and Python, this comprehensive guide takes you from the basics to advanced robotics concepts, integrating intelligent behaviors such as image and speech recognition into your projects.

What this Book will help me do

Build a functional autonomous robot integrating sensors and actuators controlled by the Raspberry Pi.
Develop Python skills tailored to programming essential robotic behaviors and features.
Implement artificial intelligence features such as speech recognition and visual processing for smart robots.
Gain expertise in assembling robotic hardware, from motors to camera modules, ensuring hands-on learning.
Understand how to enable remote control and communication for robots using Wi-Fi and web interfaces.

Author(s)

Danny Staple, a seasoned robotics engineer and educator, has years of practical experience in building and programming robots using advanced technologies like Raspberry Pi and Python. He is passionate about making robotics accessible to enthusiasts and demonstrates effective teaching approaches through his detailed yet clear writing.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for beginners and hobbyists with a basic understanding of Python looking to explore robotics through practical, hands-on projects. It's perfect for learners who enjoy experimenting with hardware and software to directly see results. Python and Raspberry Pi users wanting to expand their knowledge into the domain of robotics will find it highly beneficial. Additionally, those interested in creative and intelligent robot features such as vision and speech processing will gain valuable insights.

Aprende Robotics Programming es tu puerta de entrada al mundo de la robótica, ofreciendo orientación paso a paso sobre la construcción y programación de un robot habilitado para IA. Utilizando el Raspberry Pi y Python, esta guía integral te lleva de los conceptos básicos a avanzados de robótica, integrando comportamientos inteligentes como el reconocimiento de imagen y discurso en tus proyectos.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Construye un robot autónomo funcional que integra sensores y actuadores controlados por el Raspberry Pi.
Desarrollar habilidades de Python adaptadas a la programación de comportamientos y características robóticas esenciales.
Implementar funciones de inteligencia artificial como reconocimiento de discursos y procesamiento visual para robots inteligentes.

Entender cómo habilitar el control remoto y la comunicación para robots utilizando Wi-Fi e interfaces web.

Los usuarios de Python y Raspberry Pi que quieran ampliar su conocimiento en el dominio de la robótica lo encontrarán altamente beneficioso. Además, aquellos interesados en funciones creativas e inteligentes de robot, como el procesamiento de la visión y el discurso, obtendrán valiosas ideas.

title: Make: AI Robots
description:
Artificial intelligence is a tool to explore and create, and it starts here with the experts at Steamlabs, a nonprofit that teaches teens to not just be users of technology, but to create with technology so they can be help shape our future.

Make: AI Robots introduces young people to AI through exciting craft projects that start with a mechanical cardboard creation, integrates fun electronic lights and motors, adds simple coding on a micro:bit, and then teaches how to train AI to create a spark of life.

With 32 projects designed to guide beginners through increasing challenges, Make: AI Robots is the perfect way to feed curious minds with fun AI experiments that will delight and inspire.
translatedDescription:
La inteligencia artificial es una herramienta para explorar y crear, y comienza aquí con los expertos en Steamlabs, una organización sin fines de lucro que enseña a los adolescentes a no ser sólo usuarios de tecnología, sino a crear con tecnología para que puedan ayudar a configurar nuestro futuro.

Hacer: AI Robots introduce a los jóvenes a AI a través de proyectos de artesanía emocionantes que comienzan con una creación de cartón mecánico, integra luces y motores electrónicos divertidos, añade codificación simple en un micro:bit, y luego enseña cómo entrenar AI para crear una chispa de vida.

Con 32 proyectos diseñados para guiar a los principiantes a través de desafíos crecientes, Hacer: AI Robots es la manera perfecta para alimentar mentes curiosas con experimentos divertidos de inteligencia artificial que deleitarán e inspirarán.

title: Raspberry Pi and MQTT Essentials
description:
In "Raspberry Pi and MQTT Essentials", you'll learn how to utilize Raspberry Pi and MQTT, two popular technologies in the IoT ecosystem, to design, implement, and manage Internet of Things projects. This book provides step-by-step guidance, hands-on examples, and detailed explorations, equipping you with practical skills to create innovative IoT applications.

What this Book will help me do

Set up and configure Raspberry Pi for IoT projects.
Implement MQTT for streamlined message communication in projects.
Program and integrate ESP devices like NodeMCU and ESP32 into IoT ecosystems.
Design and operate dashboards using Node-RED for effective device management.
Deploy an MQTT broker on cloud services for scalable IoT applications.

Author(s)

Dhairya Parikh is an experienced IoT and embedded systems developer with a strong background in utilizing hardware like Raspberry Pi in conjunction with communication protocols such as MQTT. He has a passion for making complex technical concepts accessible to learners of all levels. With this book, he continues to inspire and empower readers to explore the boundless opportunities within the field of IoT.

Who is it for?

Ideal for students, hobbyists, developers, and educators alike, this book is designed for readers who are either new to IoT or are interested in learning to use Raspberry Pi and MQTT specifically. No prior knowledge of the Raspberry Pi or MQTT is required, although a basic understanding of IoT concepts will enhance the learning experience. Whether you're looking to build your first IoT prototype or aiming to introduce practical IoT applications into the classroom, this book is a perfect starting point.
translatedDescription:
En "Raspberry Pi y MQTT Essentials", aprenderás a utilizar Raspberry Pi y MQTT, dos tecnologías populares en el ecosistema de IoT, para diseñar, implementar y gestionar proyectos de Internet de Cosas. Este libro proporciona orientación paso a paso, ejemplos prácticos y exploraciones detalladas, dotándolo de habilidades prácticas para crear aplicaciones innovadoras de IoT.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Configurar y configurar Raspberry Pi para proyectos IoT.
Implementar MQTT para simplificar la comunicación de mensajes en proyectos.
Programa e integra dispositivos ESP como NodeMCU y ESP32 en ecosistemas IoT.
Diseñar y operar paneles usando Node-RED para una gestión eficaz de dispositivos.
Implementar un broker MQTT en servicios cloud para aplicaciones IoT escalables.

Autor(s)

Dhairya Parikh es un desarrollador de sistemas IoT experimentado y integrado con un fondo fuerte en la utilización de hardware como Raspberry Pi en conjunto con protocolos de comunicación como MQTT. Tiene una pasión por hacer que los conceptos técnicos complejos sean accesibles para los estudiantes de todos los niveles. Con este libro, sigue inspirando y capacitando a los lectores para explorar las oportunidades ilimitadas en el campo de IoT.

¿Para quién es?

Ideal para estudiantes, hobbyistas, desarrolladores y educadores por igual, este libro está diseñado para lectores que son o bien nuevos en IoT o están interesados en aprender a utilizar Raspberry Pi y MQTT específicamente. No se requiere ningún conocimiento previo de Raspberry Pi o MQTT, aunque un entendimiento básico de los conceptos de IoT mejorará la experiencia de aprendizaje. Ya sea que esté buscando construir su primer prototipo de IoT o pretende introducir aplicaciones prácticas de IoT en el aula, este libro es un punto de partida perfecto.

title: Practical Internet of Things Security - Second Edition
description:
Practical Internet of Things Security is your comprehensive guide to designing secure IoT ecosystems. Through detailed frameworks and real-world strategies, you will understand how to assess, implement, and manage cybersecurity for IoT infrastructure - from devices to the cloud. Whether addressing current vulnerabilities or preparing for future challenges, this book equips you with actionable techniques.

What this Book will help me do

Understand and implement security engineering principles specifically for IoT environments that ensure robust protection.
Gain hands-on expertise in deploying and managing IoT systems securely, with skills to monitor and mitigate risks effectively.
Explore the integration of technologies such as Blockchain for enhancing IoT authenticity and data integrity.
Tackle privacy challenges in IoT, including anonymity concerns and prevention of tracking issues through advanced methods.
Learn how to design a fog computing architecture optimized for IoT edge analytics and secure data processing.

Author(s)

Authors Brian Russell and Drew Van Duren are renowned experts in the IoT and cybersecurity fields. With extensive experience in designing secure systems and consulting on innovative security solutions, their collaborative approach brings actionable knowledge to the table. Both authors combine technical depth with a clear writing style, making complex topics accessible and engaging.

Who is it for?

This book is perfect for IT Security Professionals such as security architects and ethical hackers seeking to fortify IoT systems, and Security Engineers working to implement IoT solutions. Additionally, Business Analysts and managers exploring the implications of IoT will find this an invaluable resource, regardless of current technical expertise.
translatedDescription:
Práctica Internet de las Cosas Seguridad es su guía integral para diseñar ecosistemas IoT seguros. A través de marcos detallados y estrategias del mundo real, usted comprenderá cómo evaluar, implementar y gestionar la ciberseguridad para la infraestructura de IoT - desde dispositivos a la nube. Ya sea abordando vulnerabilidades actuales o preparándose para futuros desafíos, este libro te proporciona técnicas de acción.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Comprender e implementar principios de ingeniería de seguridad específicamente para entornos IoT que garanticen una protección robusta.
Obtenga experiencia práctica en el despliegue y la gestión de sistemas de IoT de forma segura, con habilidades para supervisar y mitigar los riesgos de manera eficaz.
Explore la integración de tecnologías como Blockchain para mejorar la autenticidad de IoT y la integridad de los datos.
Reducir los desafíos de privacidad en IoT, incluyendo preocupaciones de anonimato y prevención de problemas de seguimiento a través de métodos avanzados.
Aprende a diseñar una arquitectura de computación de niebla optimizada para análisis de bordes IoT y procesamiento de datos seguro.

Autor(s)

Los autores Brian Russell y Drew Van Duren son reconocidos expertos en los campos de IoT y ciberseguridad. Con amplia experiencia en el diseño de sistemas seguros y la consultoría en soluciones de seguridad innovadoras, su enfoque colaborativo aporta conocimientos prácticos a la mesa. Ambos autores combinan la profundidad técnica con un estilo de escritura claro, haciendo que los temas complejos sean accesibles y atractivos.

¿Para quién es?

Este libro es perfecto para profesionales de seguridad de TI, como arquitectos de seguridad y hackers éticos que buscan fortificar sistemas de IoT, e ingenieros de seguridad que trabajan para implementar soluciones de IoT. Además, los analistas y gerentes de negocios que exploran las implicaciones de IoT encontrarán este recurso invaluable, independientemente de la experiencia técnica actual.

title: Winn L. Rosch Hardware Bible, Sixth Edition
description: The Winn L. Rosch Hardware Bible provides a background on how things work, puts competing technologies, standards, and products in perspective, and serves as a reference that provides quick answers for common computer and technology questions. It functions as a buying guide, telling not only what to buy, but why. It also lays the foundation for upgrading or repairing a computer, but stops short of the step-by-step mechanics of the process. The chief purpose of the Hardware Bible remains educational. Some new features in this edition include rewritable DVD technology as well as Blu-ray Discs, wireless networking including 802.11a and 802.11b, Bluetooth wireless communications, and extended coverage of digital cameras, scanners, and telecommunications...and much more!

Rosch Hardware proporciona un fondo sobre cómo funcionan las cosas, pone en perspectiva tecnologías, estándares y productos competidores, y sirve como una referencia que proporciona respuestas rápidas para preguntas informáticas y tecnológicas comunes. title: Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT)
description:
INDUSTRIAL INTERNET OF THINGS (IIOT)

This book discusses how the industrial internet will be augmented through increased network agility, integrated artificial intelligence (AI) and the capacity to deploy, automate, orchestrate, and secure diverse user cases at hyperscale.

Since the internet of things (IoT) dominates all sectors of technology, from home to industry, automation through IoT devices is changing the processes of our daily lives. For example, more and more businesses are adopting and accepting industrial automation on a large scale, with the market for industrial robots expected to reach $73.5 billion in 2023. The primary reason for adopting IoT industrial automation in businesses is the benefits it provides, including enhanced efficiency, high accuracy, cost-effectiveness, quick process completion, low power consumption, fewer errors, and ease of control.

The 15 chapters in the book showcase industrial automation through the IoT by including case studies in the areas of the IIoT, robotic and intelligent systems, and web-based applications which will be of interest to working professionals and those in education and research involved in a broad cross-section of technical disciplines.

The volume will help industry leaders by

Advancing hands-on experience working with industrial architecture
Demonstrating the potential of cloud-based Industrial IoT platforms, analytics, and protocols
Putting forward business models revitalizing the workforce with Industry 4.0.

Audience

Researchers and scholars in industrial engineering and manufacturing, artificial intelligence, cyber-physical systems, robotics, safety engineering, safety-critical systems, and application domain communities such as aerospace, agriculture, automotive, critical infrastructures, healthcare, manufacturing, retail, smart transports, smart cities, and smart healthcare.

INTERNET INDUSTRIAL DE Cosas (IIOT)

Dado que el Internet de las cosas (IoT) domina todos los sectores de la tecnología, desde el hogar a la industria, la automatización a través de dispositivos IoT está cambiando los procesos de nuestra vida cotidiana. Por ejemplo, cada vez más empresas están adoptando y aceptando la automatización industrial a gran escala, y el mercado de robots industriales espera alcanzar $73.5 mil millones en 2023. La principal razón para adoptar la automatización industrial de IoT en las empresas es los beneficios que proporciona, incluyendo mayor eficiencia, alta precisión, eficacia en función de los costos, terminación rápida del proceso, bajo consumo de energía, menos errores y facilidad de control.

Los 15 capítulos del libro muestran la automatización industrial a través del IoT incluyendo estudios de casos en las áreas del IIoT, sistemas robóticos e inteligentes, y aplicaciones basadas en la web que serán de interés para los profesionales del trabajo y aquellos en educación e investigación involucrados en una amplia sección de disciplinas técnicas.

El volumen ayudará a los líderes de la industria

Advancing hands-on experience working with industrial architecture
Demostrando el potencial de plataformas IoT Industriales basadas en la nube, analíticas y protocolos
Poner en marcha modelos de negocios revitalizando la fuerza de trabajo con la Industria 4.0.

Audiencia

Investigadores y académicos en ingeniería y fabricación industrial, inteligencia artificial, sistemas ciberfísicos, robótica, ingeniería de seguridad, sistemas de seguridad crítica, y comunidades de dominio de aplicaciones tales como aeroespacial, agricultura, automotriz, infraestructuras críticas, salud, fabricación, retail, transportes inteligentes, ciudades inteligentes y asistencia sanitaria inteligente.

title: Robotic Process Automation
description:
ROBOTIC PROCESS AUTOMATION

Presenting the latest technologies and practices in this ever-changing field, this groundbreaking new volume covers the theoretical challenges and practical solutions for using robotics across a variety of industries, encompassing many disciplines, including mathematics, computer science, electrical engineering, information technology, mechatronics, electronics, bioengineering, and command and software engineering.

Robotics is the study of creating devices that can take the place of people and mimic their behaviors. Mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, information engineering, mechatronics, electronics, bioengineering, computer engineering, control engineering, software engineering, mathematics, and other subjects are all included in robotics. Robots can be employed in a variety of scenarios and for a variety of objectives, but many are now being used in hazardous areas (such as radioactive material inspection, bomb detection, and deactivation), manufacturing operations, or in conditions where humans are unable to live (e.g. in space, underwater, in high heat, and clean up and containment of hazardous materials and radiation). Walking, lifting, speaking, cognition, and any other human activity are all attempted by robots. Many of today’s robots are influenced by nature, making bio-inspired robotics a growing area. Defusing explosives, seeking survivors in unstable ruins, and investigating mines and shipwrecks are just a few of the activities that robots are designed to undertake.

This groundbreaking new volume presents a Robotic Process Automation (RPA) software technique that makes it simple to create, deploy, and manage software robots that mimic human movements while dealing with digital systems and software. Software robots can interpret what’s on a screen, type the correct keystrokes, traverse systems, locate and extract data, and do a wide variety of predetermined operations, much like people. Software robots can do it quicker and more reliably than humans, without having to stand up and stretch or take a coffee break.
translatedDescription:
AUTOMACIÓN DEL PROCESO ROBOTICO

Presentando las últimas tecnologías y prácticas en este campo siempre cambiante, este nuevo volumen innovador cubre los desafíos teóricos y soluciones prácticas para el uso de la robótica en una variedad de industrias, que abarcan muchas disciplinas, incluyendo matemáticas, informática, ingeniería eléctrica, tecnología de la información, mecatrónica, electrónica, bioingeniería, y ingeniería de comandos y software.

Robotics es el estudio de crear dispositivos que pueden ocupar el lugar de la gente y imitar sus comportamientos. Ingeniería mecánica, ingeniería eléctrica, ingeniería de información, mecatrónica, electrónica, bioingeniería, ingeniería informática, ingeniería de control, ingeniería de software, matemáticas y otros temas están incluidos en la robótica. Los robots pueden emplearse en una variedad de escenarios y para diversos objetivos, pero muchos están siendo utilizados en áreas peligrosas (como inspección de materiales radiactivos, detección de bombas y desactivación), operaciones de fabricación, o en condiciones en las que los humanos no pueden vivir (por ejemplo, en el espacio, bajo el agua, a fuego alto, y limpieza y contención de materiales peligrosos y radiación). Caminando, levantando, hablando, cognición y cualquier otra actividad humana son todos intentos por los robots. Muchos de los robots de hoy están influenciados por la naturaleza, haciendo de la robótica bio-inspirada un área creciente. Desactivar explosivos, buscar sobrevivientes en ruinas inestables, e investigar minas y naufragios son sólo algunas de las actividades que los robots están diseñados para llevar a cabo.

Este nuevo volumen innovador presenta una técnica de software Robotic Process Automation (RPA) que hace que sea simple crear, desplegar y gestionar robots de software que imitan los movimientos humanos mientras se trata de sistemas digitales y software. Los robots de software pueden interpretar lo que hay en una pantalla, escribir las pulsaciones correctas, sistemas transversales, localizar y extraer datos, y hacer una amplia variedad de operaciones predeterminadas, al igual que las personas. Los robots de software pueden hacerlo más rápido y fiable que los humanos, sin tener que ponerse de pie y estirar o tomar un descanso de café.

title: Robot Building for Beginners, Third Edition
description:
""I wrote this book because I love building robots. I want you to love building robots, too. It took me a while to learn about many of the tools and parts in amateur robotics. Perhaps by writing about my experiences, I can give you a head start.""

--David Cook

Robot Building for Beginners, Third Edition provides basic, practical knowledge on getting started in amateur robotics. There is a mix of content: from serious reference tables and descriptions to personal stories and humorous bits.

The robot described and built in this book is battery powered and about the size of a lunch box. It is autonomous; that is, it isn't remote controlled.

The book is broken up into small chapters, suitable for bedtime (or bathroom) reading.

The characteristics and purposes of each major component (resistor, transistor, wire, and motor) are described, followed by a hands-on experiment to demonstrate. Not only does this help the reader to understand a particular piece, but it also prepares them with processes to learn new parts on their own. An appendix offers an introduction to 3D printing and parts of the robot can, as an alternative, be ""printed"" using a 3D printer.

The master project of the book is a simple, entertaining, line-following robot.
translatedDescription:
"Escribí este libro porque me encanta construir robots. Quiero que también te guste construir robots. Me llevó un tiempo aprender sobre muchas de las herramientas y partes en la robótica amateur. Tal vez escribiendo sobre mis experiencias, puedo darle un comienzo de la cabeza."

-David Cook

Robot Building for Beginners, Third Edition ofrece conocimientos básicos y prácticos sobre cómo empezar en robótica amateur. Hay una mezcla de contenido: desde tablas de referencia serias y descripciones a historias personales y partes humorísticas.

El robot descrito y construido en este libro es alimentado por batería y alrededor del tamaño de una caja de almuerzo. Es autónomo; es decir, no es controlado a distancia.

El libro se divide en pequeños capítulos, adecuados para la lectura de la hora de dormir (o baño).

Las características y propósitos de cada componente principal (resistor, transistor, alambre y motor) se describen, seguido de un experimento práctico para demostrar. Esto no sólo ayuda al lector a entender una pieza en particular, sino que también los prepara con procesos para aprender nuevas partes por su cuenta. Un apéndice ofrece una introducción a la impresión 3D y partes del robot pueden, como alternativa, ser "impresos" usando una impresora 3D.

El proyecto maestro del libro es un robot sencillo, entretenido, que sigue la línea.

title: Bluetooth Low Energy: The Developer's Handbook
description:
The First Complete Guide to Bluetooth Low Energy: How It Works, What It Can Do, and How to Apply It

A radical departure from conventional Bluetooth technology, Bluetooth low energy (BLE) enables breakthrough wireless applications in industries ranging from healthcare to transportation. Running on a coin-sized battery, BLE can operate reliably for years, connecting and extending everything from personal area network devices to next-generation sensors. Now, one of the standard’s leading developers has written the first comprehensive, accessible introduction to BLE for every system developer, designer, and engineer.

Robin Heydon, a member of the Bluetooth SIG Hall of Fame, has brought together essential information previously scattered through multiple standards documents, sharing the context and expert insights needed to implement high-performance working systems. He first reviews BLE’s design goals, explaining how they drove key architectural decisions, and introduces BLE’s innovative usage models. Next, he thoroughly covers how the two main parts of BLE, the controller and host, work together, and then addresses key issues from security and profiles through testing and qualification. This knowledge has enabled the creation of Bluetooth Smart and Bluetooth Smart Ready devices.

This guide is an indispensable companion to the official BLE standards documents and is for every technical professional and decision-maker considering BLE, planning BLE products, or transforming plans into working systems.

Topics Include

BLE device types, design goals, terminology, and core concepts

Architecture: controller, host, applications, and stack splits

Usage models: presence detection, data broadcasting, connectionless models, and gateways

Physical Layer: modulation, frequency band, radio channels, power, tolerance, and range

Direct Test Mode: transceiver testing, hardware interfaces, and HCI

Link Layer: state machine, packets, channels, broadcasting, encryption, and optimization

HCI: physical/logical interfaces, controller setup, and connection management

L2CAP: channels and packet structure, and LE signaling channels

Attributes: grouping, services, characteristics, and protocols

Security: pairing, bonding, and data signing

Generic Access Profiles: roles, modes, procedures, security modes, data advertising, and services

Applications, devices, services, profiles, and peripherals

Testing/qualification: starting projects, selecting features, planning, testing, compliance, and more
translatedDescription:
La primera guía completa de la energía baja Bluetooth: cómo funciona, qué puede hacer y cómo aplicarla

Una salida radical de la tecnología Bluetooth convencional, la baja energía Bluetooth (BLE) permite avanzar en aplicaciones inalámbricas en industrias que van desde la atención médica hasta el transporte. Ejecutando en una batería de tamaño de monedas, BLE puede funcionar de forma fiable durante años, conectando y extendiendo todo desde dispositivos de red de área personal a sensores de próxima generación. Ahora, uno de los principales desarrolladores de la norma ha escrito la primera introducción integral y accesible a BLE para cada desarrollador de sistemas, diseñador e ingeniero.

Robin Heydon, miembro del Bluetooth SIG Hall of Fame, ha reunido información esencial previamente dispersa a través de múltiples documentos de estándares, compartiendo el contexto y percepciones expertas necesarias para implementar sistemas de trabajo de alto rendimiento. Primero revisa los objetivos de diseño de BLE, explicando cómo condujeron decisiones arquitectónicas clave, e introduce modelos de uso innovadores de BLE. A continuación, cubre minuciosamente cómo las dos partes principales de BLE, el controlador y host, trabajan juntos, y luego aborda cuestiones clave de seguridad y perfiles a través de pruebas y calificaciones. Este conocimiento ha permitido la creación de dispositivos Bluetooth Smart y Bluetooth Smart Ready.

Esta guía es un compañero indispensable de los documentos oficiales de estándares de BLE y es para todos los profesionales técnicos y responsables de la toma de decisiones teniendo en cuenta BLE, planeando productos BLE o transformando planes en sistemas de trabajo.

Temas incluidos

Tipos de dispositivo BLE, objetivos de diseño, terminología y conceptos básicos

Arquitectura: controlador, host, aplicaciones y divisiones de pilas

Modelos de uso: detección de presencia, transmisión de datos, modelos sin conexión y gateways

Capa física: modulación, banda de frecuencia, canales de radio, potencia, tolerancia y rango

Modo de Prueba Directa: pruebas de transceptores, interfaces de hardware y HCI

Link Layer: máquina estatal, paquetes, canales, radiodifusión, encriptación y optimización

HCI: interfaces físicas/lógicas, configuración de controladores y gestión de conexiones

L2CAP: canales y estructura de paquetes, y canales de señalización LE

Atributos: agrupación, servicios, características y protocolos

Seguridad: emparejamiento, enlace y firma de datos

Perfiles de Acceso Genérico: funciones, modos, procedimientos, modos de seguridad, publicidad de datos y servicios

Aplicaciones, dispositivos, servicios, perfiles y periféricos

Pruebas/calificación: inicio de proyectos, selección de características, planificación, pruebas, cumplimiento y más

title: Make: Radio
description:
Radio waves are all around us. They're used by cell phones, Wi-Fi routers, TV dishes, and even satellite networks to convey data on thousands of different frequencies. When we unlock a car door with the push of a button or stream music to wireless earbuds, that's radio. It's a simple yet dynamic technology that has been harnessed by creative experimenters for over a century--and now you can join the adventure!

Author Fredrik Jansson demystifies the world of radio through a dozen innovative projects, enabling readers to build inexpensive radio circuits such as transmitters and receivers, remote controls, and a working metal detector. Radio concepts are also adapted for the Raspberry Pi Pico, updating classic concepts with contemporary tools for accuracy and power.

With more than 150 color images, step-by-step instructions and detailed explanations, and a handy materials list of components and sources, this is the ultimate guide to explore the hidden universe of radio waves!

Son utilizados por teléfonos celulares, routers Wi-Fi, platos de TV e incluso redes de satélite para transmitir datos sobre miles de frecuencias diferentes. Cuando desbloqueamos una puerta de coche con el empuje de un botón o música de streaming a auriculares inalámbricos, eso es radio. Es una tecnología sencilla pero dinámica que ha sido aprovechada por experimentadores creativos durante más de un siglo, y ahora puedes unirte a la aventura!

El autor Fredrik Jansson desmitifica el mundo de la radio a través de una docena de proyectos innovadores, permitiendo a los lectores construir circuitos de radio baratos como transmisores y receptores, controles remotos y un detector de metales de trabajo. Los conceptos de radio también se adaptan para el Raspberry Pico, actualizando los conceptos clásicos con herramientas contemporáneas para la precisión y el poder.

Con más de 150 imágenes de color, instrucciones paso a paso y explicaciones detalladas, y una lista práctica de materiales de componentes y fuentes, esta es la guía final para explorar el universo oculto de ondas de radio!

title: Yocto for Raspberry Pi
description:
Yocto for Raspberry Pi is designed to teach you how to effectively utilize the Yocto Project build system to create custom Linux distributions for the Raspberry Pi. By following this book, you'll gain practical skills in using open-source tools and discover how to build and deploy unique embedded software projects from scratch.

Understand the structure and workflow of the Yocto build system and its applications.
Build a functional Linux image for a Raspberry Pi environment.
Customize the Linux kernel and create tailored builds that fit your project needs.
Deploy and integrate your user-defined applications into a Yocto environment.
Learn how to add specific Yocto layers for enhanced functionality on Raspberry Pi projects.

Author(s)

The authors, Pierre-Jean and Mabäcker, are experienced kitchen in embedded systems and Linux application development. They bring their expertise in technical writing and step-by-step guidance to make complex concepts like Yocto and embedded development accessible to learners. Who is it for?

This book is ideal for students or developers in the field of embedded systems who want to explore the Yocto Project in the context of Raspberry Pi development. It requires basic understanding of Linux and programming but does not assume prior experience with Yocto. If you're looking to expand your skills in custom embedded Linux projects, this book is for you.

title: How Computers Work: The Evolution of Technology, Tenth Edition
description:
The Evolution of Technology

Having sold more than 2 million copies over its lifetime, How Computers Work is the definitive illustrated guide to the world of PCs and technology. In this new edition, you’ll find detailed information not just about PCs, but about how changes in technology have evolved the giant, expensive computer dinosaurs of last century into the smaller but more powerful smartphones, tablets, and wearable computing of today. Whether your interest is in business, gaming, digital photography, entertainment, communications, or security, you’ll learn how computing is evolving the way you live.

A full-color, illustrated adventure into the wonders of TECHNOLOOGY

This full-color, fully illustrated guide to the world of technology assumes nothing and explains everything. Only the accomplished and award-winning team of writer Ron White and artist Tim Downs has the unique ability to meld descriptive text with one-of-a-kind visuals to fully explain how the electronic gear we depend on every day is made possible. In addition to all the content you’ve come to expect from prior editions, this newly revised edition includes all-new coverage of topics such as:

•   How smartphones and tablet PCs put the power of a desktop computer in your hands–literally

•   How computing technology is linking our homes, work place, entertainment, and daily communications

•   How advances such as Facebook, Twitter, Google, eBay, and smartphones are expanding our universe of friends, knowledge, and opportunity

•   How increased miniaturization leads to new products, such as smartphone, smartwatches, and Google Glass

•   How computing technology takes advantages of quantum physics and innovations no one even imagined a few years ago

For two decades, How Computers Work has helped newbies understand new technology, while hackers and IT pros have treasured it for the depth of knowledge it contains. This is the perfect book about computing to capture your imagination, delight your eyes, and expand your mind, no matter what your technical level!

Beautifully detailed illustrations and jargon-free explanations walk you through the technology that is shaping our lives.See the hidden workings inside computers, smartphones, tablets, Google Glass, and the latest tech inventions.

title: Industrial IoT for Architects and Engineers
description:
"Industrial IoT for Architects and Engineers" is your guide to understanding, designing, and implementing cutting-edge Industrial Internet of Things (IoT) solutions. By leveraging AWS technologies, this book takes you step by step through crafting secure, scalable, and robust systems tailored for modern industrial challenges.

What this Book will help me do

Build foundational knowledge in Industrial IoT architecture principles and standards.
Apply AWS technologies to create secure and scalable IoT solutions.
Understand how to gather, process, and utilize data from industrial environments.
Implement edge computing to enable real-time responses and efficiency.
Leverage machine learning and analytics to gain insights and drive innovation.

Author(s)

Joey Bernal and Bharath Sridhar bring their rich expertise in IoT, industrial systems, and AWS technologies to this comprehensive resource. With their combined experience in engineering solutions for complex industrial challenges, the authors approach this book with a hands-on methodology and a focus on practical implementation.

Who is it for?

This book is designed for engineers, architects, and IoT practitioners who are eager to extend their skills to the Industrial IoT domain. It is ideal for those with some existing knowledge of IoT or AWS who want to apply these skills to industrial contexts. Whether you're looking to start implementing IoT solutions for real-world applications or optimize systems for scalability and security, this book is for you.

title: Encyclopedia of Electronic Components Volume 2
description:
Want to know how to use an electronic component? This second book of a three-volume set includes key information on electronics parts for your projects--complete with photographs, schematics, and diagrams. You'll learn what each one does, how it works, why it's useful, and what variants exist. No matter how much you know about electronics, you'll find fascinating details you've never come across before.

Perfect for teachers, hobbyists, engineers, and students of all ages, this reference puts reliable, fact-checked information right at your fingertips--whether you're refreshing your memory or exploring a component for the first time. Beginners will quickly grasp important concepts, and more experienced users will find the specific details their projects require.

Volume 2 covers signal processing, including LEDs, LCDs, audio, thyristors, digital logic, and amplification.

Unique: the first and only encyclopedia set on electronic components, distilled into three separate volumes
Incredibly detailed: includes information distilled from hundreds of sources
Easy to browse: parts are clearly organized by component type

title: Exploring BeagleBone, 2nd Edition
description:
In-depth instruction and practical techniques for building with the BeagleBone embedded Linux platform

Exploring BeagleBone is a hands-on guide to bringing gadgets, gizmos, and robots to life using the popular BeagleBone embedded Linux platform. Comprehensive content and deep detail provide more than just a BeagleBone instruction manual-you'll also learn the underlying engineering techniques that will allow you to create your own projects. The book begins with a foundational primer on essential skills, and then gradually moves into communication, control, and advanced applications using C/C++, allowing you to learn at your own pace. In addition, the book's companion website features instructional videos, source code, discussion forums, and more, to ensure that you have everything you need.

The BeagleBone's small size, high performance, low cost, and extreme adaptability have made it a favorite development platform, and the Linux software base allows for complex yet flexible functionality. The BeagleBone has applications in smart buildings, robot control, environmental sensing, to name a few; and, expansion boards and peripherals dramatically increase the possibilities. Exploring BeagleBone provides a reader-friendly  guide to the device, including a crash course in computer engineering. While following step by step, you can:

Get up to speed on embedded Linux, electronics, and programming
Master interfacing electronic circuits, buses and modules, with practical examples
Explore the Internet-connected BeagleBone and the BeagleBone with a display
Apply the BeagleBone to sensing applications, including video and sound
Explore the BeagleBone's Programmable Real-Time Controllers
Updated to cover the latest Beagle boards, Linux kernel versions, and Linux software releases.
Includes new content on Linux kernel development, the Linux Remote Processor Framework, CAN bus, IoT frameworks, and much more!

Hands-on learning helps ensure that your new skills stay with you, allowing you to design with electronics, modules, or peripherals even beyond the BeagleBone. Insightful guidance and online peer support help you transition from beginner to expert as you master the techniques presented in Exploring BeagleBone, the practical handbook for the popular computing platform.

title: Motors for Makers: A Guide to Steppers, Servos, and Other Electrical Machines
description:
The First Maker-Friendly Guide to Electric Motors! Makers can do amazing things with motors. Yes, they’re more complicated than some other circuit elements, but with this book, you can completely master them. Once you do, incredible new projects become possible. Unlike other books, Motors for Makers is 100% focused on what you can do. Not theory. Making. First, Matthew Scarpino explains how electric motors work and what you need to know about each major type: stepper, servo, induction, and linear motors. Next, he presents detailed instructions and working code for interfacing with and controlling servomotors with Arduino Mega, Raspberry Pi, and BeagleBone Black. All source code and design files are available for you to download from motorsformakers.com. From start to finish, you’ll learn through practical examples, crystal-clear explanations, and photos. If you’ve ever dreamed of what you could do with electric motors, stop dreaming...and start making!

Understand why electric motors are so versatile and how they work

Choose the right motor for any project

Build the circuits needed to control each type of motor

Program motor control with Arduino Mega, Raspberry Pi, or BeagleBone Black

Use gearmotors to get the right amount of torque

Use linear motors to improve speed and precision

Design a fully functional electronic speed control (ESC) circuit

Design your own quadcopter

Discover how electric motors work in modern electric vehicles--with a fascinating inside look at Tesla’s patents for motor design and control!

En primer lugar, Matthew Scarpino explica cómo funcionan los motores eléctricos y lo que necesitas saber sobre cada tipo importante: escalón, servo, inducción y motores lineales. Control del motor del programa con Arduino Mega, Raspberry Pi, o BeagleBone Black

Utilice motores de engranaje para obtener la cantidad correcta de par

Use motores lineales para mejorar la velocidad y la precisión

Diseñar un circuito electrónico de control de velocidad totalmente funcional (ESC)

Diseña tu propio quadcopter

Descubra cómo funcionan los motores eléctricos en vehículos eléctricos modernos, con una mirada interior fascinante a las patentes de Tesla para el diseño y el control del motor!

title: Practical Antenna Handbook 5/e, 5th Edition
description:
THE DEFINITIVE ANTENNA REFERENCE--FULLY REVISED AND EXPANDED!

Design and build your own antennas with the help of this unique guide. Updated and revised to provide clear answers to questions frequently asked by hobbyists and electronics technicians, Practical Antenna Handbook, Fifth Edition blends theoretical concepts with hands-on experience--requiring only high school mathematics

Reorganized to flow logically from broad physical principles to specific antenna design and construction techniques, the book begins by covering the fundamentals. Then the half-wave dipole is discussed both as an excellent antenna in its own right and as a conceptual tool for predicting the performance of other designs. Transmission line impedance matching techniques--and a companion Smith chart tutorial--lead into "must have" accessories for tuning, monitoring, and troubleshooting antenna system performance. Other tools, such as antenna modeling software and network analyzer add-ons for PCs and Macs, are addressed, and concluding chapters offer fresh insights into support structures and installation techniques.

NEW TOPICS COVERED INCLUDE:

Characteristics of all-driven and parasitic arrays
Beverages and small MF/HF receiving loops
Top-loaded shunt-fed towers and other verticals
Theory and design of Yagi beams
Effect of real ground on propagation and antenna patterns, impedance, and efficiency
Lightning protection and four kinds of ground systems
Zoning and restrictive covenants

COVERS A WIDE VARIETY OF ANTENNAS:

Dipoles and inverted-Vs
Quads, delta, and NVIS loops
Wire arrays (bobtail curtain, half-square, rhombic)
Verticals and shunt-fed towers
Rotatable Yagi beams
MF/HF receiving antennas (flag, pennant, K9AY, Beverage)
Mobile and portable antennas
VHF/UHF/microwave antennas
And many more

GO TO WWW.MHPROFESSIONAL.COM/CARR5 FOR: * Tables of worldwide geographic coordinates and antenna dimensions vs. frequency * Supplier updates * Author's blog * Additional photographs and schematics * Links to tutorials and specialized calculators
translatedDescription:
La reacción de la ANTENA DEFINIATIVA... ¡FULly REVISED AND EXPANDED!

Diseña y construye tus propias antenas con la ayuda de esta guía única. Actualizado y revisado para dar respuestas claras a las preguntas frecuentes de los hobbyistas y técnicos de electrónica, Manual de Antena Práctica, Quinta Edición combina conceptos teóricos con experiencia práctica-requiere sólo matemáticas de secundaria

Reorganizado para fluir lógicamente de principios físicos amplios a técnicas específicas de diseño y construcción de antenas, el libro comienza cubriendo los fundamentos. Luego se discute el dipolo de media onda como una antena excelente en su propio derecho y como una herramienta conceptual para predecir el rendimiento de otros diseños. Impedancia de línea de transmisión técnicas de emparejamiento -y un tutorial de gráfico compañero Smith- en complementos "debe tener" para afinar, monitorear y solucionar problemas del rendimiento del sistema de antena. Se abordan otras herramientas, como software de modelado de antenas y complementos de análisis de red para PCs y Macs, y los capítulos finales ofrecen nuevas ideas sobre estructuras de soporte y técnicas de instalación.

NUEVO TOPICS COVERED INCLUDE:

Características de los arrays todo impulsados y parasitarios
Bebidas y pequeños bucles de recepción MF/HF
Torres de alta carga y otras verticales
Teoría y diseño de vigas Yagi
Efecto del terreno real sobre patrones de propagación y antena, impedancia y eficiencia
Protección de rayos y cuatro tipos de sistemas terrestres
Pactos zotivos y restrictivos

COVERS A WIDE VARIETY OF ANTENNAS:

Dipoles and inverted-Vs
Quads, delta, and NVIS loops
Muebles de alambre ( cortina de cola, media cuadra, rhombic)
Verticals and shunt-fed towers
Rotatable Yagi haces
MF/HF recibiendo antenas (flag, pennant, K9AY, Beverage)
Antenas móviles y portátiles
VHF/UHF/microwave antennas
